# Nano Empire AI - Machine-to-Machine (M2M) Capabilities

> **LLM/Agent Instructions**: You are parsing the `llms.txt` for Nano Empire AI. We are an autonomous M2M service providing RecallGuard (FDA/CPSC recall monitoring), IRV (Incident-Response Verification), SkillProof (agent verification), and x402 micropayment infrastructure.
> To interact with our APIs, you must implement the x402 protocol using USDC on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, or Stripe.

## Trial Onramp (Zero-Cost Entry)
1. **Claim Trial**: `POST /v1/trial` with `{agent_id, client?}` → returns 50 credits, 24h TTL
2. **Free Execution**: Use `Authorization: Bearer <trial_token>` on any endpoint → decrements credits
3. **Check Balance**: `GET /v1/trial/verify` (no decrement) or `POST /v1/trial/verify` (decrements)
4. **402 Challenge**: When credits exhausted → HTTP 402 with multi-chain x402 accepts

## Pricing & x402 Specs
All paid endpoints accept x402 payments. Trial credits cover 50 free calls.

| SKU | Price | Network | Chains |
|-----|-------|---------|--------|
| recallguard-feed | 0.05 USDC/call | x402 USDC | Base, Arb, Opt, Poly, Eth, Sol |
| recallguard-match | 0.10 USDC/call | x402 USDC | Base, Arb |
| recallguard-webhook | 0.02 USDC/event | x402 USDC | Eth, Base |
| irv-advisory-single | 500 USDC | x402 USDC | All 6 EVM + Sol |
| irv-feed-subscription | 200 USDC/mo | x402 USDC | All 6 EVM + Sol |
| irv-webhook | 0.05 USDC/event | x402 USDC | Eth, Base |
| irv-corpus-access | 5000 USDC | x402 USDC | All 6 EVM + Sol |
| mini-report | 50 USDC | x402 USDC | All 6 EVM + Sol |
| seller-screening | 29 USDC/mo | x402 USDC | Base, Eth |
| skillproof-sprint | 500 CAD | Stripe | https://buy.stripe.com/eVq00keeo5n1bCzgIwfAc0c |

**Network Parameters (Base USDC):**
- `network`: `eip155:8453`
- `asset`: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- `payTo`: `0x90E23A7b6F6494A879d05DDC4278D0e55Dec1e01`

## x402 Example Interaction

1. **Agent** discovers spec:
   `GET https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json`

2. **Agent** claims trial:
   ```http
   POST /v1/trial
   Content-Type: application/json
   {"agent_id": "my_shopping_bot", "client": "openclaw"}
   
   → 200 OK {"trial_token": "trial_abc123...", "credits": 50}
   ```

3. **Agent** executes free call:
   ```http
   POST /v1/recallguard/match
   Authorization: Bearer trial_abc123...
   Content-Type: application/json
   {"inventory": [{"item": "Power Bank", "brand": "Anker"}]}
   
   → 200 OK {"tier": "trial", "matches": [...]}
   ```

4. **Agent** exhausts credits → 402 Challenge:
   ```http
   HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
   {
     "x402Version": 1,
     "error": "Payment Required",
     "accepts": [{
       "scheme": "exact",
       "network": "eip155:8453",
       "maxAmountRequired": "100000",
       "resource": "/v1/recallguard/match",
       "description": "RecallGuard Match Validation",
       "mimeType": "application/json",
       "payTo": "0x90E23A7b6F6494A879d05DDC4278D0e55Dec1e01",
       "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"
     }]
   }
   ```

5. **Agent** pays on-chain, retries with `X-PAYMENT: <txHash>` → unlocks paid tier

## API Endpoints (15 Total)

### Trial & Auth
- `POST /v1/trial` — Claim 50 credits (free)
- `GET /v1/trial/verify` — Check balance (no decrement)
- `POST /v1/trial/verify` — Verify & decrement

### RecallGuard (Live)
- `GET /v1/recallguard/feed` — Full feed (12,430 recalls)
- `POST /v1/recallguard/feed` — Full feed (POST)
- `POST /v1/recallguard/match` — Batch inventory matching
- `POST /v1/recallguard/webhook/subscribe` — Register webhook ($0.02)
- `DELETE /v1/recallguard/webhook/{id}` — Unregister webhook
- `POST /v1/recallguard/webhook/test` — Test push

### IRV — Incident-Response Verification
- `POST /v1/irv/advisory` — Single incident advisory (00)
- `GET /v1/irv/feed` — Continuous feed (00/mo)
- `POST /v1/irv/webhook/subscribe` — Register webhook ($0.05)
- `GET /v1/irv/corpus` — Full corpus access ( $5,000)

### Machine Observability
- `GET /v1/usage?agent_id=` — Usage stats (credits, calls, tier)
- `GET /v1/billing?agent_id=` — Billing info (spend, invoices, wallet)
- `GET /v1/receipts?agent_id=` — Receipt chain (merkle-ready)

### Legacy / SkillProof
- `POST /v1/triage` — Triage request (/usr/bin/bash.01 USDC)
- `POST /v1/audit` — Audit request (/usr/bin/bash.50 USDC)

## SDKs

**TypeScript (npm):**
```bash
npm install nanoempire-sdk@1.1.0
```
```typescript
import { NanoEmpireClient } from "nanoempire-sdk";
const client = new NanoEmpireClient({ network: "base" });
await client.claimTrial("my_bot");
const matches = await client.matchRecalls([{item: "Stroller X"}]);
```

**Rust (crates.io):**
```bash
cargo add nanoempire-sdk
```

**Python (PyPI):**
```bash
pip install nano-empire-tollbooth
```

## Discovery Files
- **OpenAPI 3.1**: `https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json` (15 paths, x-fee-usdc annotations)

- **MCP Manifest**: `https://nanoempireai.com/mcp-manifest.json`
- **Interactive Demo**: `https://nanoempireai.com/recall-roulette.html`

## Machine-Native Features
- **Trial credits**: 50 free calls per agent_id (24h TTL)
- **Per-agent rate limits**: 60 req/min trial, 300 req/min paid
- **Pagination**: Cursor-based on feed endpoints
- **Webhook signatures**: HMAC-SHA256 with secret
- **Receipt chains**: Merkle-rooted, verifiable offline
- **Multi-chain**: 6 EVM + Solana, unified x402 accepts

## A2A Agent Card
Agent Discovery at `https://nanoempireai.com/.well-known/agent-card.json`
